purpose: Independent timing arithmetic and aggregation validation, without importing Frontier trading code.
sample: One event-horizon row per policy and horizon, chosen by minimum SHA256(policy|signal_session|symbol|horizon); no return-based selection.
raw_arithmetic: Decimal precision50 on observed same-source raw opens,closes and adjusted closes; all three timing logs/simple returns plus entry intraday and overnight gap.
aggregation: Independently reconstruct every primary complete-active-date mean,median,event denominator and selected/no-signal count from saved cohorts and horizon1 CSV rows.
